title: From maintained data to sales documents
boundary: Document nodes are runtime projections, not master-data entities. The map shows what is proposed, determined, copied, changed, or carried forward.
mental_model: The BP role enables a business view. FLCU01 exposes customer sales-area data; FLCU00 covers FI customer company-code data.
Partner functions define who plays a role. Partner determination configuration defines which roles are required, changeable, and how they are sourced.
A sales document consumes master data and stores runtime values. After that, changing master data does not automatically rewrite an existing document.
Follow-on documents receive relevant values from preceding documents, but target-document procedures and copy-control logic can change the result.

document_nodes.title: Outbound Delivery Header
master_inputs: relevant partners carried from the order
shipping point / route results from order processing
important_runtime_values: ship-to and other required delivery partners
inspect_when: delivery created for the wrong receiver
shipping execution differs from order expectation
output goes to the wrong recipient

document_nodes.title: Outbound Delivery Item
inspect_when: plant or product context looks inconsistent

document_nodes.title: Billing Document Header
master_inputs: pricing results or repricing inputs depending on copy control
inspect_when: tax or account assignment is unexpected
pricing differs from the source document

document_nodes.title: Billing Document Item
document_nodes.purpose: Billable product/service line and accounting-relevant detail.
inspect_when: item is unexpectedly billing relevant or not relevant

bp_roles.label: Customer (Sales)
bp_roles.scope: General customer identity plus sales-area data for Sales and Distribution.
bp_roles.why_it_matters: This is the main BP role for sales processing. It is where sales-area attributes and customer partner assignments become available.

bp_roles.label: FI Customer
bp_roles.scope: Company-code customer data for Financial Accounting.
bp_roles.why_it_matters: Keep it separate from FLCU01. Billing may post to FI, but sales-area behavior is not company-code master data.

partner_functions.title: Sold-to Party
partner_functions.business_meaning: The party that places the order and owns the main sales relationship.
document_usage: Usually the entry point for partner determination in the sales order.
Stored in sales-order partner data and used as a major source of commercial defaults.
Relevant partners are carried to follow-on documents according to their partner procedures and document flow.

partner_functions.title: Ship-to Party
partner_functions.business_meaning: The party and location that physically receives the goods.
document_usage: Its delivering plant is a standard fallback source for sales-item plant determination.
Its address and shipping context are critical for outbound delivery.

partner_functions.title: Bill-to Party
partner_functions.business_meaning: The party that receives the invoice.
document_usage: Present in sales-order partner data when required by the procedure.
Transferred to billing context as a key invoice-recipient role.

partner_functions.title: Payer
document_usage: Present in sales-order partner data when required.
Becomes central in billing and payment context.
A payer different from sold-to is a common reason to inspect which partner owns a value.

determination_rules: Partner determination procedure defines which partner functions are allowed or mandatory for the customer master and documents.
For a sales document, the procedure can define whether a partner is changeable and can use source control instead of always reading the sold-to party.
Master-data partner assignments provide candidate partners. Configuration decides how the document consumes them.
If several partners are valid for one function, user selection can be required.
If a mandatory function is missing, the document becomes incomplete until the partner is supplied.
Partner functions can exist at header and, where configured, at item level.
Relevant partners can be copied to follow-on documents; the target document partner procedure still defines what is required.

field_lineage.rule: Master relationships propose who can play each role; partner procedures define allowed, mandatory, source and changeability behavior.
It participates in pricing-procedure determination; it is not itself the pricing procedure.
Standard precedence is customer-material first, then ship-to customer, then material.
Do not debug the shipping point as an isolated field; trace the three inputs and their source.
The product contributes an input. Configuration determines the item category and therefore delivery/billing behavior.
Customer-specific product number, text and supported logistics defaults specialize the generic customer/product combination.
Treat the document value as runtime data. Check which partner supplied it and whether later copy/redetermination logic changed it.
Customer and product classifications are determinants; the calculated tax condition is a document result.
Master attributes feed account determination; the accounting document is downstream runtime output.
Text determination chooses a source and copies content. After copy, document text can have its own lifecycle.
After substitution, inspect the resulting product master because item category, ATP and shipping may now read different product attributes.
This relationship does not merely default a value; it can allow or reject item processing.

Partner determination establishes the business role. Address determination then uses the configured address rule, BP address usages, and validity periods to propose the physical location. For customer address determination, SAP checks the target usage first and falls back to the general address overview when the required future validity interval is not fully covered.
sequence: Partner is added or changed in the SD document.
Read address-determination settings for the partner function and partner object.
Resolve the target address usage, for example BBP003 Send goods to Delivery Address.
Evaluate customer addresses valid from the current system date through December 31, 9999.
If the target usage is empty or does not cover the full interval, also search the BP address overview.
Propose the valid BP address; a later manual document-specific address is not master data.

field_lineage.rule: The proposal supplies candidate products and quantities. Once copied, the items consume current product and Sales controls as normal order items.

copy_semantics.meaning: A master value is offered as an initial document value and can often be changed.
A mechanism calculates/selects a runtime value from master data plus configuration.
A value is transferred into the current document and then becomes document data.
A relevant value/partner is transferred from a preceding document to a follow-on document.
A follow-on step calculates the value again rather than blindly copying it; this depends on the function and configuration.

assessment_paths.question: Why is the wrong ship-to or payer in the order?
Why is the plant wrong for only one customer/product?
Why did billing use a different party than expected?
assessment_paths.check: source document partners → billing partner procedure → copied/changed runtime partner

assessment_paths.question: Why does the order have the correct ship-to partner but the wrong physical address?
assessment_paths.check: partner identity → address determination setting → address usage → validity/fallback → BP address UUID or document-specific override
